assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Triangle ABC with sides labelled a, b, c, its incircle in grey and the incentre I in red; a point X outside the triangle is joined to A, B and C by blue segments and to I by a red segment.

difficulty_rationale: Parts (a) and (b) are guided (the angle bisector theorem twice, and the weighted analogue of the centroid identity); evaluating the minimum as abc needs one meaningful trick, putting X = A, B, C into the identity and combining the three equations.
